summary.business_type: Local Service: single-physician medical practice (YMYL), Lugano
summary.score_basis: Weighted: Technical 22%, Content 23%, On-Page 20%, Schema 10%, Performance 10% (lab only), AI Search Readiness 10%, Images 5%. Local SEO 63 and SXO gap 63 reported separately.

top_findings.title: Unsupported systemic antimicrobial PDT claims on /terapia-fotodinamica/ (×4 languages, plus meta, OG, JSON-LD and llms.txt)
'Reumatologo / Rheumatologist' title and H1, but the doctor's FMH title is Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation
Claims outrun the evidence on invasive laser, exosome and acupuncture pages; factual error; device-network badges shown as credentials
Pages don't match the main queries: no pain-therapy hub, condition pages, costs page or 'fisiatra' term
Little off-site proof: no visible reviews, brand confused with Centromedico, inconsistent directory data

quick_wins: Remove the editing notes visible to patients in all 4 languages (grep list in findings/content.md H6)
Rewrite the 5 meta descriptions that overstate their pages; regenerate OG, JSON-LD descriptions and llms.txt from the page bodies
Fix 'doppia membrana', add a conflict-of-interest note to the Weber 2024 citation, relabel ISLA/ELC badges as network, not credentials
Schema: [Person, IndividualPhysician] + practicesAt, GLN identifier, clinic alternateName; add a visible 'independent practice' sentence
Add 'fisiatra' and the doctor's name to the homepage title/H1; add 'Lugano' to utility titles; verify Bing WMT + IndexNow

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 96/96 pages 200, self-canonical, indexable, in the sitemap; no orphans or broken links
Hreflang textbook-correct (it, de-CH, fr-CH, en, x-default), 0 mismatches between HTML and sitemap
Single-hop 301s (www, index.html, trailing slash); real 404 with noindex; legacy WordPress paths handled
Strong security headers (HSTS, hash-pinned CSP, XFO, nosniff); static HTML with zero external JS

findings.title: HSTS without preload
findings.description: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, but no preload token.
findings.recommendation: Add preload and submit to hstspreload.org once every subdomain is HTTPS-only.

findings.title: Two very long Italian slugs
findings.description: 87–103-character legacy slugs vs 20–34 in DE/FR/EN.
findings.recommendation: Only shorten them during a restructure, with a 301 and updated hreflang and sitemap.

findings.title: No IndexNow / Bing WMT evidence
findings.description: No key file; Copilot draws on Bing's index.
findings.recommendation: Verify Bing WMT; add IndexNow pings to the build.

findings.title: Generic utility-page titles
findings.description: Privacy/Kontakt/Contact titles omit Lugano.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Contatti – Swiss Centro Medico Lugano' and similar.

findings.title: HTTP→HTTPS not verifiable
findings.description: The audit environment's proxy blocks plain HTTP.
findings.recommendation: Check manually: curl -I http://swisscentromedico.ch/ should return a single 301.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Physician byline and 'verificata dal medico' date on every service page
DOI-linked 'Fonti scientifiche' sections and disclaimers
GLN and UID on the legal notice; 4-language parity, translated rather than templated

findings.title: Systemic antimicrobial PDT claims
findings.description: /terapia-fotodinamica/: IV-infused photosensitiser against 'patogeni batterici, virali e parassitari', 'senza antibiotici sistemici', curcumin and hypericin listed. Not supported by the cited sources; repeated in meta, OG, JSON-LD and llms.txt.
findings.recommendation: Remove the systemic content; keep topical PDT/aPDT uses that have evidence; regenerate every derived snippet.

findings.title: Invasive laser pages lack evidence and risk information
findings.description: IV, interstitial and intra-articular laser pages: no clinical evidence, unclear indications, cartilage regeneration claimed without a source.
findings.recommendation: Add evidence status, indications, risks and sources, or merge into one page.

findings.title: Exosome page transparency and accuracy
findings.description: No product origin or regulatory status; one 5-subject study with a probable undisclosed conflict of interest; 'doppia membrana' is wrong.
findings.recommendation: Add an origin/status/evidence box; fix the error; disclose or drop the citation.

findings.title: Acupuncture indication list goes beyond the evidence
findings.description: Lists heart/circulation, diabetes, thyroid, fertility and oncology support; RAC diagnosis called 'preciso'.
findings.recommendation: Tier the indications by evidence; remove 'preciso'.

findings.title: Device-maker network shown as a credential
findings.description: ISLA / European Laser Clinics badges on all 96 pages and in the laser hero.
findings.recommendation: Relabel as 'Rete / formazione laser'; put the independent credentials first.

findings.title: Editing notes visible to patients
findings.description: 'il sito attribuisce', 'studi con DOI', 'Perché non parlate più della colonna?', 'sta sulla pagina gemella' on 11 IT pages plus translations.
findings.recommendation: One human editorial pass per language.

findings.title: No costs or insurance information
findings.description: No CHF figures; basic-insurance position only implied; generic insurance FAQ repeated on about 80 pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a costs and insurance page plus a per-page box.

findings.title: Thin sub-pages and sibling cannibalisation
findings.description: 6 sub-pages with 248–340 unique words; the classical acupuncture page is 43% contained in /agopuntura/; the regenerative hub duplicates its spokes.
findings.recommendation: Merge or differentiate; cut the hubs down to real overviews.

findings.title: Credentials hard to verify
findings.description: No physician page or MedReg link; 6 variants of the doctor's name.
findings.recommendation: Build a physician profile page with verification links; standardise the name.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, localised titles (29–60 chars) and metas (121–156 chars) on all 96 pages
One H1 per page; logical heading hierarchy; breadcrumbs; flat internal linking

findings.title: 'Reumatologo' title/H1 vs FMH PM&R title
findings.description: /reumatologo/ ×4: the H1 says rheumatologist; the doctor holds FMH Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the wording with FMH / the cantonal office; retitle around the discipline and the real title.

findings.title: Meta descriptions overstate their page bodies
findings.description: 5 metas (×4 languages) claim more than the pages say.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite them; generate metas, OG and llms.txt from the page body.

findings.title: Specialty term and doctor name missing from targeting
findings.description: 'fisiatra' on 0 pages; doctor name not in the homepage title or H1.
findings.recommendation: Add both naturally.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD @graph on 96/96 pages with consistent @ids across languages
MedicalClinic with geo, openingHoursSpecification, hasMap, availableService; BreadcrumbList on all 92 inner pages
No deprecated types; FAQPage correctly absent

findings.title: Physician typing
findings.description: ['Person','Physician']: Physician is in the Organization branch.
findings.recommendation: Use ['Person','IndividualPhysician'] + practicesAt the clinic.

findings.title: Disambiguation properties missing
findings.description: No clinic alternateName/description; no GLN identifier on the doctor; clinic and doctor sameAs mixed; OneDoc sameAs hard-coded to Italian.
findings.recommendation: Add alternateName, description and identifier; split and localise sameAs.

findings.title: Recommended properties missing
findings.description: No medicalAudience on MedicalWebPage; no currenciesAccepted.
findings.recommendation: Add them.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lighthouse perf 95–99; LCP 0.9–2.0 s; CLS ≤ 0.04; TBT 0 ms (lab)
WebP via picture, preloaded hero with fetchpriority=high, preloaded fonts, immutable caching, Brotli
Zero third-party requests; lazy Maps facade on /contatti/

findings.title: No field data
findings.description: No CrUX/PSI data (no API key; PSI returned 429). Lab only; INP can't be measured in the lab.
findings.recommendation: Monitor the GSC Core Web Vitals report and CrUX once traffic allows.

findings.title: Render-blocking stylesheet
findings.description: A single 6.1 KB stylesheet; about 230–570 ms estimated, but every page is already in the Good band.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS (with a CSP hash) only if field LCP regresses.

findings.title: TTFB 0.5–0.76 s
findings.description: Measured through a proxy, so it may be inflated.
findings.recommendation: Check from Switzerland; consider a CDN or server cache.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed; 18 user agents tested, no firewall blocking
Accurate llms.txt covering all 96 URLs
Lighthouse Agentic Browsing 3/3; clean ARIA tree

findings.title: Brand and name collisions with nothing to tell them apart
findings.description: Confused with Swiss Medical Network 'Centromedico'; YouTube results show Argentina's Swiss Medical and an unrelated podcaster for the doctor's name.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible 'independent practice' sentence, alternateName and a GLN identifier.

findings.title: FAQ passages don't stand alone
findings.description: 42/97 English questions don't name the treatment; the same insurance answer is repeated on about 80 pages.
findings.recommendation: Name the treatment and Lugano in each question; give each answer a first sentence that restates the subject.

findings.title: Fragment leads instead of definitions
findings.description: 17 of 20 service pages open without a definitional sentence.
findings.recommendation: Add a 40–60-word definitional lead.

findings.title: Directory data inconsistent
findings.description: local.ch has the wrong hours (09–17) and a different name form.
findings.recommendation: Clean up the NAP data; split sameAs by entity.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0/512 images missing alt text; alt text descriptive and translated
All images have width/height; eager hero, lazy elsewhere
416/512 served as WebP via picture; 88 with multi-width srcset

findings.title: GIF badge
findings.description: isla_logo.gif on every page.
findings.recommendation: Re-export as SVG or WebP.

findings.title: Single-size content photos
findings.description: No smaller srcset candidate for content photos.
findings.recommendation: Add a ~480w candidate.

categories.name: Local SEO (supplementary)
what_works: NAP identical across 96 pages, schema and llms.txt
GBP claimed (review link on /contatti/)
Zürich/Lugano split disclosed and cross-linked

findings.title: No reviews and no request process
findings.description: Zero visible reviews on Google or OneDoc.
findings.recommendation: Set up a compliant post-visit review request at a steady pace.

findings.title: GBP category and OneDoc specialty
findings.description: The GBP category can't be verified from here; OneDoc labels the doctor 'agopuntore' for every booking.
findings.recommendation: GBP primary: Physiatrist; OneDoc specialty: Medicina fisica e riabilitazione, plus visit types.

findings.title: Citations
findings.description: local.ch wrong hours and name; Medicosearch, search.ch, doctorfmh.ch and society directories not linked.
findings.recommendation: Clean up and expand the listings; add them to sameAs.

categories.name: Search Experience (supplementary)
what_works: Physician-led service pages match acupuncture and laser SERPs
Calls to action and trust above the fold; sticky mobile call/book bar

findings.title: No pain-therapy hub
findings.description: 6/9 results for 'terapia del dolore Lugano' are dedicated service pages; the site has none.
findings.recommendation: Build /terapia-del-dolore/ and point the homepage link at it.

findings.title: No condition layer
findings.description: Back pain, neck pain, knee arthrosis and headache SERPs have little physician-led content.
findings.recommendation: Add 4–6 hybrid condition pages.

findings.title: Cost transparency
findings.description: The insurance-checking persona scores lowest (53).
findings.recommendation: Publish CHF ranges and the LAMal position.

phases.name: Phase 0: Measurement
items: Verify GSC and Bing WMT; baseline queries and indexed pages
AI-answer prompt panel baseline
Manual HTTP→HTTPS check

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical fixes (YMYL risk)
items: Remove systemic aPDT claims and regenerate snippets
Resolve the 'Reumatologo' wording after compliance confirmation
Fix 'doppia membrana', disclose the conflict of interest, relabel network badges
Rewrite 5 overstating metas and regenerate OG, JSON-LD and llms.txt

phases.name: Phase 2: Trust layer and quick wins
items: Editorial pass to remove editing notes (×4 languages)
Tier evidence on acupuncture and invasive laser pages
Consolidate cannibalising sibling pages
Entity disambiguation (visible sentence + schema)
NAP and citation clean-up
Align GBP category and OneDoc specialty
Start the reviews process
On-page quick wins and IndexNow

phases.name: Phase 3: Align pages with intent
items: Costs and insurance page + per-page box
/terapia-del-dolore/ hub
4–6 condition pages (IT first)
Physician profile page
'Fisiatra' targeting
Quotable passages and definitional leads

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring and iteration
items: Third-party corroboration (video, directories, GP referral page)
Performance hygiene if field data calls for it
Governance: claims traceable to sources; snippets generated from the page body
Quarterly re-audit; monthly AI prompt panel

limitations: The bundled fetchers refuse the session's loopback proxy; the crawl and captures used scripts in raw/
No GSC, GA4, CrUX or PSI data (no credentials); performance is lab only
No backlink API keys; the backlink review was skipped
SERP data is directional (US-located tools, not google.ch/Ticino)
HTTP→HTTPS on port 80 is unverifiable (blocked by the proxy)
Compliance points need verification with FMH / cantonal authorities
